title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
review:
this, in my opinion, is the best movie marvel has ever made. their magnum opus. not only did they have an arc for EVERY single character, but they single handedly represented depression and loneliness in one of the best ways i’ve seen on a screen. the genuine tonal shift from the comedy movies the first and second are to starting off this film in the most depressing way possible is such a great way to convey what we’re in store for. the comedy did land every single time and felt perfectly placed and wasn’t overdone to outweigh the actual emotional scenes. it’s just so beautifully done, and choosing animals to display abuse is a great way to draw investment and emotional support, since those tiny little raccoons are so damn cute. the high evolutionary is so unlikable, genuinely unredeemable and not worth living, but they spared him anyways. he might be one of marvels best villains entirely, his motivation, ambition, and personality are just pure evil with no real light to shine. they did everything right in this movie, it was a perfect end to their trilogy.
